mapper.select: select q.* from ai_storage_cleanup q where q.next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp and not exists ( select 1 from ai_knowledge_document d where d.storage_bucket = q.bucket and d.storage_object_key = q.object_key ) order by q.next_attempt_at, q.id limit 20 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update ai_storage_cleanup set attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = current_timestamp + interval '1 minute' where id = #{id}
